problem: A future pending-source-only packet retains the original case and previous job ID, but not the previous observation itself. The worker must fetch another result to know how an earlier unknown was resolved.

adopted_basis.principle: For each new data point record date, changed data and impact on the existing pillar.

project_adaptation: Freeze only the completed previous qualitative review summary/observation, result SHA and source snapshot bindings into the next packet. Preserve the original case; never turn new observations into original author conditions.
compatibility: Old packets without the field remain readable/claimable, explicitly marked legacy in the opt-in view. No reconstruction on historical worker rendering, DB migration, finance or source rewrite.
validation_scope: Prior job completed, same case/issue/version, matching actual completion and declared review time, and previous source hashes covered by current case. Invalid reference holds this case only. New workers never fetch a changing live previous result for their frozen view.
